instruction: On the desktop, open 55_10.pptx, find slide 3, and modify the bottom-left cell in the table to have centered text.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the text alignment in the bottom-left cell (row 2, col 0 in 0-based indexing) of the 3x3 table on slide 3 to center. The original table has '7' in this cell. The evaluator checks if the text alignment equals 'CENTER'. Postconfig includes Ctrl+S to save the file before evaluation.
